features: DAILY ZIKR COUNTER UP TO 9999: Replace traditional prayer beads with precise digital counting technology. Press the button to count your daily Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, and Allahu Akbar.
VIBRATION AT MILESTONE COUNTS: Ring vibrates when you reach significant daily milestones like 33, 66, 99, or 100 counts, providing satisfying tactile feedback for your Zikr sessions.
5 DAILY PRAYER REMINDERS: Never miss a prayer with discreet vibration alerts for all 5 daily Salah times. The gentle buzz reminds you without disturbing others.
AZAN ALARM CLOCK FUNCTION: Built-in Azan alarm ensures you're always aware of prayer times, keeping you connected to your faith throughout your busy day.
TRACK SPIRITUAL PROGRESS: Sync with the iQibla Life app to record your daily Zikr counts and track your spiritual journey over time .
WATERPROOF FOR WUDU AND BEYOND: IP67/IP68 waterproof construction allows you to wear the ring during wudu, showering, or in rainy conditions without worry
CLEAR OLED DISPLAY: Built-in 0.49-inch OLED screen shows your current count, next prayer time, and battery status clearly in any lighting
LONG-LASTING BATTERY LIFE: High-capacity battery provides up to 3-7 days of normal use on a single charge, depending on model and usage
COMPORTABLE UNISEX DESIGN: Sleek 18mm black finish fits comfortably on any finger for both men and women, complementing any attire from casual to formal.
EASY ONE-BUTTON OPERATION: Simple CNC button allows effortless counting throughout your day, making daily Zikr practice convenient and accessible anywhere
